question: Which of the following acts gave the British Indian government the authority to arrest anyone without a trial?
solution:
The correct answer is __**The Rowlatt Act**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **The Rowlatt Act** was enacted in 1919 by the British colonial government in India.
 
• This act gave the British Indian government the authority to arrest and detain individuals without a trial.
 
• The act was officially known as the Anarchical and Revolutionary Crimes Act of 1919.
